title: 3D Charged Particle Movements and Acceleration Vectors
full_prompt: Create a 3D Manim scene named `Introduce3dMovements` that visualizes a charged particle moving in 3D space. The visualization should include a custom `ChargedParticle` (represented as a 3D sphere with a sign) and an `AccelerationVector` pinned to the particle. The camera should rotate in 3D to show the spatial movement. Implement custom physics helper functions like `lorentz_force` and `points_to_particle_info` to calculate the field or forces, and update the particle's position and acceleration dynamically. The scene must demonstrate smooth 3D camera transitions, particle movement, and dynamic vector updating.

common_failure_modes.pattern: 3D camera rotation causing rendering crashes in older Manim versions
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure compatibility with ManimGL's 3D camera system and avoid using deprecated 2D camera methods.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Updater functions referencing non-existent attributes of ChargedParticle
common_failure_modes.note: Ensure ChargedParticle class is fully implemented with position history tracking.
